articles.summary: ANCHORAGE, Alaska, and MEDFORD, Ore., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Northrim BanCorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: NRIM) (“Northrim” or the “Company”), the holding company of Northrim Bank, and PBCO Financial Corporation (“PBCO”), the holding company of People’s Bank of Commerce (“People’s Bank”), an Oregon state-chartered bank, jointly announced today that they have received all required shareholder approvals related to Northrim’s proposed acquisition of PBCO. The final vote results on the proposal presented at the special meeting of Northrim’s shareholders on October 20, 2026, will be set forth in Northrim’s Current Report on Form 8-K to be filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. PBCO’s shareholders approved the merger agreement with Northrim at a special meeting of PBCO’s shareholders held on October 20, 2026. “We appreciate the strong support our shareholders have shown for this merger. articles.summary: ANCHORAGE, Alaska - October 15, 2026 - Northrim BanCorp, Inc. (NASDAQ:NRIM) (Northrim or the Company) today reported net income of $14.4 million, or $0.63 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $15.3 million, or $0.68 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026, and $27.1 million, or $1.20 per diluted share, in the third quarter a year ago. The decrease in the third quarter 2026 profitability as compared to the third quarter a year ago was mostly due to an increase in provision for credit losses in the third quarter of 2026, as well as the gain on sale of certain assets by Pacific Wealth Advisors in the third quarter of 2025. Dividends per share in the third quarter of 2026 increased to $0.17 per share as compared to $0.16 per share in the second quarter of 2026 and the third quarter of 2025.
